3-column layout with a small gap, vertically centred via parent

The items are verically centred within the row using "align-items: centre" on the flex parent, applied with the "centre-vertical-row" class.

3-column layout with a medium gap, vertically centred another way

The items are vertically centred within the row using "align-self: centre" on the flex child, applied with the "centre-item" class. Note that the "row" class can be used for multiple rows - it is set up to wrap as needed. This example is 6 .one-third .flex-item elements within one .row.
